Also, the error says "END_TYPE expected instead of ''" which suggests the type definition itself has issues. In CODESYS 3.5, the syntax should be:


```
TYPE EState : 
(
    IDLE    := 0,
    OPENING := 1,
    CLOSING := 2,
    FAULT   := 3
) END_TYPE;
END_TYPE
```
